requirements.title: LLT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING_A shall be default character or ASCII character, and STRING_B shall be character with the same kind type parameter as STRING_A.
requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures initialize result variables to non-default or opposite sentinels before invoking the intrinsic and assert only properties fixed by 16.9: exact logical, integer, kind, character, shape, or bit-pattern observations. Processor-dependent approximations are separated from exact result obligations. Unnumbered argument shall-restrictions are source-control restrictions only and are not promoted to diagnostic facets.

S16.9.127-001 intrinsics_16_9_p runtime fixture: LLT is exercised with default ASCII STRING_A and same-kind character STRING_B operands.

requirements.definition: For ASCII strings, unequal lengths are compared after right blank padding of the shorter string; LLT is true exactly for STRING_A preceding STRING_B in the ASCII collating sequence, and false otherwise.

requirements.title: LLT non-ASCII comparison result is processor dependent
requirements.definition: A LLT comparison result is processor dependent once either string contains a character outside the ASCII character set.

pending.LLT-non-ASCII-result-processor-dependent: No portable oracle for a fixed truth value: p5 makes any result processor dependent once either string contains a non-ASCII character; future exact LLT fixtures restrict operands to ASCII characters.
